name: Fisher King
title: Grail Knight
summary: Grant Immortality to your Allies and Sustain their Life over the centuries of battle.
lore: Suffering a wound that will not heal, King Pellam stood eternal guard over… something. A cauldron to revive the dead? The Holy Grail? Legends differ. He spent his time fishing a nearby river, wracked with pain but ready to defend his charge. Now something has driven him from his duties. He wanders in despair, unable to escape his agony or even to die.
